text: According to the Heine-Borel theorem as stated in the book, a subset of ℝⁿ is compact if and only if it is closed and bounded.
explanation: This is exactly the Heine-Borel characterization the book gives for ℝⁿ. The equivalence is special to finite-dimensional ℝⁿ: in a general metric space compactness is equivalent to being complete and totally bounded, not merely closed and bounded.
